tools.name: ping
tools.description: Check that the service is up. Returns status, service name, version and server time. 確認服務狀態，回傳狀態、服務名稱、版本與伺服器時間。

tools.name: list_data_sources
tools.description: List the official Taiwan government sources behind this service, with dataset codes, URLs, licence, sync status and how many factors each holds. 列出本服務整合的官方資料來源：資料集代碼、網址、授權、同步狀態與係數數量。

tools.description: Get one factor in full by ID: the original government record, unit, applicable year, boundary, official source, version, whether it can be used for calculation directly, and usage limits. Find the ID with search_emission_factors first. 依係數 ID 取得完整資訊：官方原始紀錄、單位、適用年度、計算邊界、官方來源、版本、是否可直接計算與使用限制。請先用 searc

tools.name: get_electricity_factor
tools.description: Get Taiwan's official electricity emission factor (kgCO2e/kWh) for a given year, published by the Energy Administration. From the 2025 factor year there are three values by usage; earlier years have one. Never substitutes another year: if the year is missing it says so and lists the years available.

tools.description: Calculate emissions for one activity: activity data × an official factor from the database. Checks units, the applicable year and whether the factor may be used for calculation, and returns the formula, kg and tonnes, the factor version and the source URL. tools.name: calculate_batch
tools.description: Calculate several activities at once, each with its own factor and source. A total is given only when every item succeeded and the items share a gas basis and boundary type; otherwise the reason is stated. 批次計算多筆活動，逐筆回傳結果與來源。只有全部成功、氣體基礎與邊界類型一致時才提供合計，否則說明不提供的原因。

tools.name: build_inventory
tools.description: Calculate several activities and arrange the results as a greenhouse gas inventory: grouped into Scope 1 (direct), Scope 2 (purchased energy) and Scope 3 (other indirect), with a subtotal per scope, Scope 1 by gas, and a Scope 1+2 total. Subtotals and totals are withheld, with the reason, when items

tools.name: compare_emissions
tools.description: Compare two calculations (for example two years). Separates the effect of changed activity data from the effect of a changed factor, and flags when the calculation method differs so the difference is not read as an actual reduction. 比較兩筆計算（例如不同年度）。區分活動量改變與排放係數改變的影響；計算方法不同時會標示，避免把差異誤讀為實際減碳成效。

tools.name: list_factor_versions
tools.description: List every recorded version of one factor, newest first. Old versions are kept so past calculations can be reproduced. 列出指定係數的所有歷史版本（新的在前）。舊版本會保留，讓過去的計算可以重現。

tools.name: check_factor_updates
tools.description: Show the sync status of each official source: when it was last checked, whether the data may be stale, and whether a difference from the official data is waiting for review. Read-only; it cannot trigger a sync or write anything. 查看各官方來源的同步狀態：最近檢查時間、資料是否可能過期、是否有與官方資料不一致而待審核的項目。唯讀，不能觸發同步或寫入。

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Explain the calculation methods, scope, data limits and official references. Read this before interpreting results or combining different kinds of factors. 說明計算方法、適用範圍、資料限制與官方依據。解讀結果或合併不同類型的係數之前請先閱讀。

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "match_activity" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Map an activity or ledger-account description (for example an electricity bill, fleet fuel, or a plastic resin purchase) plus an optional unit to candidate offi…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_data_sources, search_emission_factors, check_factor_updates · Private data: get_emission_factor, calculate_emissions · Public sink: calculate_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_data_sources, search_emission_factors, check_factor_updates · Private data: get_emission_factor, calculate_emissions · Public sink: calculate_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
